summary: VPN disconnects every few minutes on home Wi-Fi
resolution: Switched the VPN client to the TCP profile and updated it to version 6.2. Fixed.

summary: Laptop battery drains in two hours
resolution: Battery replaced under warranty. Laptop swapped for a loaner for one day.

summary: Cannot open the Finance portal after password change
resolution: Cleared the cached single sign-on token and re-enrolled multi-factor authentication.
Replaced the USB-C dock with the approved model from the IT catalogue.

summary: Clicked a link in a phishing email
resolution: Password reset and sessions revoked. Reported to the security team. No data accessed.
